name: MATCH, IS, HAS, and EXISTS
desc: MATCH guards and subaction scope; type-strict scalar equality; partial and exact recursive object/array matching; scoped HAS/IS overrides; alternate targets and boolean value results; existence and arbitrary property names; reference and function results; EXPR construction versus explicit matching; and error trapping. NODE, EXPR, ALL, NOT, NONE, COPY, and AT support context checks. Sequence captures, regex matching, fuzzy matching, dates, and resource limits are left to dedicated suites.
